display_name: 独立时域频域恢复网络源 IQ GPU 训练
description: 从随机初始化的直接双域 IQ 恢复网络学习时域和频域修正；训练无 DURA、无 F、无 TX 标签和目标数据。

data.representation: paired received/clean IQ; direct recovery uses only received IQ

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: F-free and TX-label-free paired source IQ training, source IQ diagnostics; no target score

checkpoint.initialization: DualDomainRecovery width 32, 42308 parameters, from scratch; zero-initialized output heads produce received IQ
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: No upstream G or F initialization or teacher; frozen DURA only after source checkpoint for diagnostics and paired test
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Random initialization; no pretrained G, F or target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch 20; no source or target score selection

rows.method: Direct received IQ plus learned dilated temporal and complex FFT-domain residual branches; no DURA input
rows.purpose: Train a distinct F-free recovery network at fixed five-epoch budget
rows.seed_notes: New model initialization 2026110612; source fit 2026110611, fixed input caches and DURA seed 2026092701; optimizer ordering 2026110613.

notes: Direct recovery model is trained from scratch on source paired IQ, no DURA/F weights or outputs, TX labels, V or target reads; DURA is loaded only after source freeze for diagnostic and ground paired comparison.
Initial zero heads reproduce received IQ; temporal and complex spectral branches learn residuals.
20 epochs differs from five-epoch DURA variants; compare total training cost explicitly.
All seven fixed Phase1 test views run and score truth-last regardless of source diagnostic.
